externalReply.text: Sera, the team understands the pressure of your Atlas launch. The latest technical information is not conclusive enough to give a firm repair date. The customer success and engineering teams will review the project and come back when they have a complete picture. The legacy route should stay in place for now. There may be value in discussing additional support once the implementation details are settled. Thank you for your patience.
